landing.hero_title: Al-Ulama Easy Editor — your AI suite for Islamic research, transcription & more
landing.hero_subtitle: Islamic GPT grounded in Quran & Hadith, plus Urdu/Arabic/English transcription, OCR, and Text-to-Speech — all in one place.

landing.plan_pro_desc: 5 hrs STT, 300 OCR pages and 200 research queries per month.
landing.plan_ultra_desc: 10 hrs STT, 2,000 OCR pages, 500 research queries. TTS and personal voice cloning (your own voice only) coming soon.
